gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Tests for {@link FilterListIterator}, which decorates a {@link ListIterator} and only lets through the elements matching a given {@link Predicate}.
ADDED i3: The fully-qualified name of the class under test, used by verifyException.
ADDED i4: Builds a {@link ListIterator} positioned at the start of a single-element list containing the given element.
ADDED i5: Builds an {@link EqualPredicate} that matches only objects equal to the given target (using the default equator).
ADDED i8: Inner filter keeps elements equal to "element"; outer filter keeps unique ones.
ADDED i9: hasNext() consumed the only element, so the backing iterator is exhausted.
ADDED i10: hasNext() advanced the backing iterator past the element.
ADDED i11: Predicate matches a different object, so the sole element is filtered out.
ADDED i12: The element was inspected (and rejected), advancing the backing iterator.
ADDED i13: A second filter sharing the backing iterator consumes the (already consumed) element.
ADDED i18: Calling hasNext() again returns the same cached result without re-advancing.
